head: YouTube bug pops videos out of full screen and cuts the sound
dek: YouTube users on Android and iPhone report on Reddit that videos jump from full screen into the mini-player on their own, and the audio stops. Sammy Fans says reports go back to early October.
details: Clearing the cache, reinstalling, restarting the phone and changing settings didn't help the users who tried. There's no confirmed fix, and Google hasn't commented yet.
where: YouTube app on Android and iPhone
means: If your videos keep shrinking and going silent, it's likely a problem in YouTube itself, not your phone.
todo: Close the video and play it again to get the sound back; if that doesn't work, close and reopen the YouTube app. Update the app when a new version comes out.
